gloss: best in the world; number one in the world

definitions.gloss: best in the world; number one in the world
definitions.explanation: The top rank or highest degree among all countries or people in the world. Used as a noun to describe the top position, or adverbially to mean 'the most in the world.'

examples.japanese: {世界一|せかいいち}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to be the best in the world.

examples.japanese: この{山|やま}は{世界一|せかいいち}{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This mountain is the tallest in the world.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{自分|じぶん}の{子供|こども}が{世界一|せかいいち}{可愛|かわい}いと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: She thinks her child is the cutest in the world.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and an adverb. As a noun: {世界一|せかいいち}を{目指|めざ}す (to aim for number one in the world). As an adverb: {世界一|せかいいち}{美|うつく}しい (the most beautiful in the world). Very common in everyday conversation, sports commentary, and advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界一|せかいいち}を{目指|めざ}す (to aim to be the best in the world)
- {世界一|せかいいち}の{記録|きろく} (world record)
- {世界一|せかいいち}{幸|しあわ}せ (the happiest in the world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本一|にほんいち}: the best in Japan — same pattern but limited to Japan
- {世界最高|せかいさいこう}: the world's best — a more formal expression
